integrity_note: Unrestricted algebraic proof and supplementary exact finite checks are supplied. Closely related general Fourier and Cartesian-product mixing identities were previously published and are acknowledged; the explicit matrix-valued rank classification is the present contribution. External independent validation has not been performed.
limitations: Identical real-symmetric layers with a uniform real rung strength only. Ranks for nonuniform couplings, unequal layers or complex interlayer phases are not established. Exact half-gap equalities are infinite-time statements and do not address near-resonances over finite windows.
title: Half-gap resonances in uniformly coupled quantum-walk bilayers
